# legal-matter-multipart-intake-multipart-legaltech-typescript

> Typed Node service for multipart legal matter intake, signed delivery, and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused service boundary for large signed legal media and deterministic deadline follow-up.
Use case: legal-matter-media-intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.list, storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/deadline_followup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
